proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.direct_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Mass Healing Word is instantaneous and involves no attack roll and no saving throw. The existing ActivationPhase union only has 'attack_roll' and 'save_gate'. A 'direct_effect' (or 'heal') phase kind is needed for spells whose effect fires unconditionally on targets with no resolution gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.heal (spell-side)
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell Effect union for spells is DamageEffect | NoneEffect. Mass Healing Word's output is HP recovery, not damage. A heal variant in the spell Effect type (mirroring the existing HealHpEffect in ClassFeatureEffect) is required for honest encoding.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr ability modifier addend
proposed_widenings.justification: The heal amount is '2d4 + spellcasting ability modifier'. DiceExpr.flat is a number literal; no field or variant exists for dynamic caster-ability-modifier references. A new field (e.g., abilityModifierBonus: 'spellcasting' | Ability) or a new DiceAmount variant is needed to express this class of heal formula — which also appears in Healing Word, Cure Wounds, and many other heal spells.
proposed_widenings.evidence: regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier

proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection.choose_up_to_fixed
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell targets up to 6 creatures with no slot-based scaling of target count. TargetSelection only offers 'one' or 'choose_up_to' (backed by SlotScaling). A fixed-count multi-target variant is needed, or SlotScaling must be clarified to allow perSlotAboveBase=0 as a stable idiom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range

notes: All required v4 atoms exist (heal, activate, spell_slot, scale_die_count, target, bonus_action_quota). The gap is entirely on the surface type layer: no ActivationPhase variant for unconditional healing, no heal in the spell Effect union, and no way to express 'flat = spellcasting ability modifier' in DiceExpr. This widening pattern recurs across all heal spells (Healing Word, Cure Wounds, Prayer of Healing, Mass Cure Wounds, etc.) — adding a direct_effect phase + heal Effect variant + ability-modifier DiceExpr field would unblock the entire heal-spell category.
